ai.title: Overview ng CAO 03-2019
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang CAO 03-2019 ang unang CAO na eksklusibong gumagawa ng malinaw na rulebook kung hanggang saan umaabot ang customs jurisdiction ng Bureau of Customs (BOC), at paano ginagamit ng mga Customs Officer o deputized officer ang kanilang police authority laban sa smuggling at iba pang customs fraud.

🔍 Breakdown: Sec. 1-2 ay scope at objectives; Sec. 3 ay 33 definitions na gagamitin sa buong CAO; Sec. 4 ang puso ng CAO - saklaw ng police authority, Mission Order, Deputization Order, Letter of Authority (LOA), Search Warrant, at Controlled Delivery; Sec. 5-12 ay administrative matters tulad ng forfeiture fund, reporting system, repealing at separability clause, at effectivity.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Isipin mo itong 'manual ng pulis ng customs' - sino ang pwedeng mag-search, saan sila pwedeng pumasok, anong papeles ang kailangan nila dalhin, at ano ang gagawin nila kung may mahuli.

📦 Halimbawa: May impormasyon na may smuggled electronics na naka-imbak sa isang warehouse sa labas ng customs zone. Bago pumasok doon ang mga Customs Officer, kailangan muna nila ng Mission Order na nag-authorize sa kanila, at kung LOA naman ang gagamitin, dapat may duly signed LOA mula sa Commissioner.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito? Dito nakasalalay kung legal o illegal ang isang search, seizure, o pag-apprehend ng BOC - kung walang tamang Mission Order, LOA, o Deputization Order, pwedeng ma-question sa korte ang buong operation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Iba-iba ang requirements ng Mission Order, LOA, Deputization Order, at Search Warrant - huwag palitan ang paggamit nila.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: Madalas itanong ang pagkakaiba ng Mission Order vs LOA vs Deputization Order vs Search Warrant - alamin kung sino ang nag-iissue ng bawat isa at para saan.

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students: Tanong: Pareho ba ang LOA at Mission Order? Sagot: Hindi - ang LOA ay para sa power to visit and inspect ng mga imported goods na openly offered for sale o nasa storage, habang ang Mission Order ay pangkalahatang authority para sa anti-smuggling operations sa labas ng customs premises.

🔗 Related Topics: CMTA Title II Chapter 3 (Power to Visit and Inspect), CMTA Title III Chapter 1-2, CMO 10-2006.

paragraphs.text: This Customs Administrative Order (CAO) implements Title II, Chapter 3; Title III, Chapter 1; Title III, Chapter 2, Sections 301, 303, 305, and 306 in relation to Section 1800; and other related provisions of Republic Act No. 10863, otherwise known as the Customs Modernization and Tariff Act (CMTA), and all other laws, rules and regulations related to customs administration.

ai.title: Legal Basis ng CAO
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sinasabi dito na ang buong CAO na ito ay 'implementing rules' lamang ng mga partikular na seksyon ng CMTA (RA 10863), partikular ang Title II Ch.3 at Title III Ch.1-2.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dapat palaging isabay basahin ang CMTA kapag ginagamit ang CAO na ito, dahil ito'y hango lang sa batas - hindi ito bagong batas kundi detalyadong paraan ng pagpapatupad.

paragraphs.text: To provide conditions for the exercise of police authority by Customs Officers or deputized officers in the apprehension of smuggled or prohibited goods, including those in the Free Zones.

paragraphs.text: Controlled Delivery – shall refer to the investigative technique of allowing an unlawful or suspect consignment of any prohibited or regulated articles defined under the CMTA and other laws enforced by the Bureau, or property believed to be derived directly or indirectly from any customs-related offense, to enter into, pass through or exit out of the country under the supervision of an authorized officer, with a view to gather evidence aimed at identifying any person involved in smuggling-related offenses, and to facilitate the prosecution of the offender.

ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Isang investigative technique kung saan hinahayaang 'tumuloy' ang suspicious shipment habang sinusubaybayan ng authorities, para mahuli ang buong syndicate.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi agad hinuhuli - sinusundan muna para makilala lahat ng kasangkot.

paragraphs.text: Constructive Customs Custody – refers to the situation where, falling short of physical seizure or possession, the Customs Officers and the owner of the goods enter into a written agreement after the inventory to the effect that the goods, subject of a Letter of Authority (LOA), shall not be removed or disposed of pending disposition or resolution on the issue of whether proper payment of duties and taxes has been made.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Parang 'hold order' - nasa pwesto pa rin ang goods pero bawal galawin.

paragraphs.text: Diversion of Goods – shall refer to an act of bringing bonded articles to some place other than its intended destination without prior authority from the Bureau. It also covers imported goods for admission into Free Zones and other similar schemes such as goods under local transit for immediate exportation, which are illegally introduced into domestic market without compliance with customs formalities or without payment of duties and taxes.

ai.content:

📖 Kahulugan: Panimula bago ilista ang mga grounds kung kailan pwedeng i-revoke ang Mission Order bago pa ito ma-implement o ma-complete.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May mga sitwasyon kung saan pwedeng bawiin agad ang Mission Order bago pa matapos.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang panimula ng Sec. 4.5.6 ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa Grounds for Revocation. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: When the mission becomes legally or physically impossible to achieve, as determined by the issuing authority;

ai.title: Legally o Physically Impossible
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Isang ground para sa revocation ay kung naging legally o physically impossible na gawin ang mission.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hal. kung nabago ang sitwasyon at hindi na pwede o makatuwiran ituloy ang operation.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.5.6.a ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa legal o physical impossibility bilang ground para sa revocation. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: b.
paragraphs.text: Inaction, ineffective execution, or abuse of authority in the implementation of the Mission Order, as determined by the issuing authority;

ai.title: Inaction, Ineffective Execution, o Abuse
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Isa pang ground ay kung may inaction, ineffective execution, o abuse of authority sa pag-implement.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kung hindi ginagawa ng maayos ang trabaho, o nag-aabuso ng authority, pwedeng i-revoke agad ang Mission Order.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.5.6.b ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa inaction, ineffective execution, o abuse of authority bilang ground para sa revocation. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: c.
paragraphs.text: In cases where the Mission Order is issued to deputized officers and the Bureau being the lead agency in anti-smuggling operations takes over the operation from the deputized officers; or

ai.title: Take-Over ng Bureau
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Isa pang ground ay kung kinuha ng BOC (bilang lead agency) ang operation mula sa deputized officers.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dahil BOC ang lead agency, pwede nilang kunin ang operation kahit na deputized officers ang orihinal na may Mission Order.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.5.6.c ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa take-over ng Bureau bilang ground para sa revocation. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: In any other instance where the Commissioner or issuing authority deems it necessary to revoke the Mission Order.

ai.title: Discretion ng Commissioner
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Catch-all ground - kahit anong ibang instance na sa tingin ng Commissioner o issuing authority ay kailangan i-revoke ang Mission Order.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May flexibility ang Commissioner - hindi limitado lang sa a,b,c na listahan ang dahilan para mag-revoke.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang catch-all ground para sa revocation sa pagtatapos ng Sec. 4.5.6 ng CAO 03-2019. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Requirement of Submission of After-Mission Report. The Customs Officers or deputized officers implementing the Mission Order shall, within twenty-four (24) hours from completion of the mission, submit the corresponding return and after-mission/operation report, accompanied by a detailed inventory of the goods seized, to the Commissioner of Customs or other authorized Customs Officer who issued the Mission Order.

ai.title: After-Mission Report (24 Hours)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sa loob ng 24 oras mula sa pagkatapos ng mission, dapat magsumite ng return at after-mission report, kasama ang detailed inventory ng seized goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mabilis na reporting requirement - hindi pwedeng i-delay ng matagal ang pag-report sa Commissioner.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: 24-hour deadline ito - importanteng tandaan para sa board exam.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.5.7 ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa After-Mission Report requirement. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: A Customs Examiner shall be designated as member of the team, who shall be in charge of the inventory of the goods.

ai.title: Customs Examiner sa Team
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dapat may designated Customs Examiner sa team na mangangasiwa sa inventory ng goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May specific role na - ang Customs Examiner ang magha-handle ng inventory documentation.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang requirement ng Customs Examiner sa pagtatapos ng Sec. 4.5.7 ng CAO 03-2019. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Who may Issue. The Commissioner shall issue a LOA pursuant to the exercise of the power to visit and inspect under Section 224, Chapter 3, Title II of the CMTA.

ai.title: Who may Issue LOA
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang Commissioner lamang ang pwedeng mag-issue ng LOA, batay sa power to visit and inspect sa ilalim ng Sec.224 CMTA.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Katulad ng Deputization Order, Commissioner lang ang authorized - walang delegation dito sa level ng District Collector.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.1 ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa Who may Issue ng LOA. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Purpose of the Issuance of a Letter of Authority. The Commissioner of Customs may issue a LOA to authorize Customs Officers to inspect, visit, and when necessary, demand evidence of payment of duties and taxes on imported goods openly offered for sale or kept in storage.

ai.title: Purpose ng LOA
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang LOA ay nag-aauthorize sa Customs Officers na mag-inspect, magvisit, at magdemand ng evidence of payment ng duties and taxes sa openly offered o stored na imported goods.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ginagamit ito kapag may tindahan o bodega na may openly displayed na imported goods na pinaghihinalaang walang bayad na duties.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.2 ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa Purpose of the Issuance of a Letter of Authority. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Who may Implement the Letter of Authority. Only Customs Officers authorized in writing by the Commissioner may implement the LOA, without prejudice to the authority of the Commissioner to require the assistance of deputized officers in the implementation of the LOA.

ai.title: Who may Implement LOA
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Customs Officers na authorized in writing lang ang pwedeng mag-implement ng LOA, pero pwede pa ring humingi ng assistance ng deputized officers ang Commissioner.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May pagkakaiba sa 'pwedeng mag-issue' (Commissioner) at 'pwedeng mag-implement' (authorized Customs Officers).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.3 ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa Who may Implement the Letter of Authority. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Duration and Termination. The validity of a LOA shall commence upon issuance and shall be deemed terminated upon completion of the mission.

ai.title: Duration and Termination ng LOA
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Valid ang LOA mula sa issuance at natatapos kapag na-complete na ang mission.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Katulad ng Mission Order, automatic na natatapos ito pagkatapos ng gawain - walang fixed na 30 o 60 days dito pero naka-tie sa completion.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.4 ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa Duration and Termination ng LOA. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Manner of Implementation. To safeguard the integrity of the power to visit and inspect, and to prevent the possible abuse thereof, the following rules shall be strictly observed:

ai.title: Panimula: Manner of Implementation
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Panimula bago ilista ang strict rules para sa implementation ng LOA, layunin ay maiwasan ang abuso.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dahil malaki ang power na ibinibigay ng LOA, may mahigpit na proseso para mapigilan ang abuso.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang panimula ng Sec. 4.6.5 ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa Manner of Implementation ng LOA. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: A Mission Order must be issued authorizing the implementation of the LOA.

ai.title: Kailangan ng Mission Order para sa LOA
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Bago i-implement ang LOA, kailangan muna ng Mission Order na nag-aauthorize nito.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Interesting ito - ang LOA mismo ay nangangailangan pa ng Mission Order bago ito ma-implement, parang 'double layer' ng authorization.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.5.a ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa requirement ng Mission Order para sa implementation ng LOA. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: b.
paragraphs.text: A LOA signed by the Commissioner shall identify the Customs Officers authorized to implement the same, the stores, stalls, exhibition places, warehouses, and enclosures where the imported articles are openly offered for sale or kept in storage, to be visited and inspected. The LOA must be shown or exhibited immediately at the start of the exercise thereof.

ai.title: Nilalaman ng LOA
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dapat nakasaad sa LOA ang authorized Customs Officers at ang specific na lugar (stores, stalls, warehouses) na bibisitahin. Ipapakita ito agad sa simula ng inspection.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi pwedeng generic lang ang LOA - dapat specific ang tao at lugar, at dapat ipakita agad kapag nag-umpisa ang inspection.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.5.b ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa nilalaman at pagpapakita ng LOA. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: c.
paragraphs.text: Pursuant to a Letter of Authority, the duly authorized Customs Officer shall:

ai.title: Panimula: Mga Gagawin ng Customs Officer sa LOA
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Panimula bago ilista ang anim na hakbang (i-vi) na dapat sundin ng Customs Officer sa pag-implement ng LOA.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Step-by-step procedure ito ng LOA implementation.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang panimula ng Sec. 4.6.5.c ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa mga gagawin ng duly authorized Customs Officer sa LOA. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: i.
paragraphs.text: Enter the premises where the smuggled goods are suspected to be stored in the presence of the lawful occupant or any person in possession of the goods, or in their absence, any two (2) witnesses who are residents of the same locality, or barangay officials or any representative from the building management or other responsible officers;

ai.title: Step 1: Pagpasok sa Premises
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Unang hakbang - pumasok sa premises sa presence ng may-ari o, kung wala, dalawang witness na residente, barangay officials, o building management representative.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kailangan ng witness palagi - para transparent ang proseso.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.5.c.i ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa pagpasok sa premises bilang unang hakbang ng LOA implementation. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: ii.
paragraphs.text: Conduct an inventory of the foreign goods if upon demand no evidence of payment is produced. The inventory shall be conducted in the presence of the owner, occupant or person in possession of the goods, as witnessed by any Customs Officer authorized to implement the LOA;

ai.title: Step 2: Inventory kung Walang Proof of Payment
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ikalawang hakbang - kung walang maipakitang evidence of payment, magsagawa ng inventory sa presence ng owner at witnessed ng Customs Officer.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi agad seizure - inventory muna, binibigyan ng chance magpakita ng proof.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.5.c.ii ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa pagconduct ng inventory kapag walang proof of payment. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: iii.
paragraphs.text: Prepare and sign the Inventory Report reflecting in detail the description and quantity of the goods. Except in cases of prohibited, restricted or regulated goods, the Inventory Report must also be signed by the owner, occupant or person in possession of the goods. In all cases, the witnesses must sign the Inventory Report;

ai.title: Step 3: Pag-prepare ng Inventory Report
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ikatlong hakbang - igawa at pirmahan ang Inventory Report na may detalye ng description at quantity. Dapat pirmado rin ng owner (maliban sa prohibited/restricted/regulated goods) at ng mga witness.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Formal na dokumento ito na nagre-record ng lahat ng nakita - importante bilang ebidensya.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.5.c.iii ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa pag-prepare ng Inventory Report. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: iv.
paragraphs.text: Furnish a copy of the Inventory Report to the owner, occupant or person in possession of the goods who must acknowledge the receipt thereof. In case the owner, occupant or person in possession of the goods refuses to receive and acknowledge the Report, a copy thereof shall be posted in any conspicuous space in the building or premises.

ai.title: Step 4: Pagbigay ng Kopya ng Inventory Report
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ikaapat na hakbang - bigyan ng kopya ng Inventory Report ang owner. Kung tumangging tumanggap, i-post na lang ito sa conspicuous space sa premises.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Due process ito - may paraan pa rin na ma-inform ang owner kahit tumangging tumanggap sila.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.5.c.iv ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa pagfurnish ng kopya ng Inventory Report. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Upon failure of the interested party to produce evidence of payment of duties and taxes within fifteen (15) days, the goods may be seized and subjected to forfeiture proceedings. In such event the provisions of the CAO on Seizure and Forfeiture Proceedings shall apply.

ai.title: 15 Days na Deadline
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung sa loob ng 15 days ay hindi pa rin naipakita ang evidence of payment, pwede nang i-seize ang goods at subject sa forfeiture.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May grace period ang owner na 15 days bago magkaroon ng seizure proceedings.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang forfeiture proceedings ay covered ng ibang CAO (hiwalay na document).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang 15-day deadline sa ilalim ng Sec. 4.6.5.c para sa seizure at forfeiture. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: v.
paragraphs.text: In cases of restricted or regulated goods wanting in government regulatory permits and clearances, immediately conduct inventory and recommend the issuance of WSD.

ai.title: Step 5: Restricted/Regulated na Walang Permit
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung restricted o regulated goods na walang kinakailangang permit o clearance, agad magconduct ng inventory at i-recommend ang WSD.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mas mabilis ang proseso dito kumpara sa regular goods na may 15-day grace period - dahil mas seryoso ang violation.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.5.c.v ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa restricted/regulated goods na walang permit. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: vi.
paragraphs.text: If during the service of the LOA prohibited articles are discovered, the same shall be confiscated under the “plain view doctrine”.

ai.title: Step 6: Plain View Doctrine
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung may prohibited articles na natuklasan habang ginagawa ang LOA inspection, pwede itong ma-confiscate sa ilalim ng 'plain view doctrine'.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kahit hindi ito ang target ng LOA, kung nakita mo at prohibited ito, pwede mo nang kunin dahil nasa harapan mo lang ito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Related sa G.R. Nos. 133254-55, April 19, 2001 na case law.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.5.c.vi ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa plain view doctrine. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: d.
paragraphs.text: The owner of the goods or his representative shall execute an Undertaking stating that the goods will not be removed, sold, or disposed of without prior authority from the Bureau. In cases where the owner, occupant or person in possession of the goods refuses to cooperate, the premises where the goods are stored shall be padlocked or sealed by the duly authorized Customs Officer and continuously guarded by the Bureau.

ai.title: Undertaking ng Owner
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dapat mag-execute ng Undertaking ang owner na hindi aalisin, ibebenta, o itatapon ang goods nang walang prior authority. Kung tumangging cooperate, pwedeng padlock o sealan ang premises.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ang legal basis para sa 'constructive customs custody' (Sec. 3.5) - may written agreement na huwag galawin ang goods.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.5.d ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa Undertaking ng owner. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: e.
paragraphs.text: Pending presentation of proof of payment of duties and taxes, the goods shall be deemed to be under constructive customs custody.

ai.title: Constructive Customs Custody habang Pending
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Habang pending ang pagpakita ng proof of payment, ang goods ay deemed under constructive customs custody.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Direktang referensiya ito sa depinisyon sa Sec. 3.5 - ipinapakita kung kailan ito applicable.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.5.e ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa constructive customs custody habang pending. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: f.
paragraphs.text: In case of seizure, the duly authorized Customs Officer shall witness the delivery of the things seized into the custody of the Collector of Customs which has jurisdiction over the area within twenty-four (24) hours from service of WSD.

ai.title: 24-Hour Delivery sa Collector
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung may seizure, dapat masaksihan ng Customs Officer ang delivery ng seized goods sa Collector of Customs sa loob ng 24 oras mula sa service ng WSD.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Katulad ng after-mission report deadline, 24-hour din ang window para sa delivery ng seized goods.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.5.f ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa 24-hour delivery requirement sa Collector. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: g.
paragraphs.text: The duly authorized Customs Officer is duty-bound to adopt all other reasonable measures deemed necessary to effectively implement the LOA.

ai.title: Duty na Gumawa ng Reasonable Measures
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Catch-all duty - dapat gumawa ng lahat ng reasonable measures para epektibong ma-implement ang LOA.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Flexibility clause ito - hindi lahat ng sitwasyon naka-cover sa specific na listahan.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.5.g ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa duty na gumawa ng reasonable measures. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: h.
paragraphs.text: The Commissioner of Customs or any Customs Officer exercising the power to visit and inspect shall tap or utilize transport facilities for the transfer of the seized goods, and suitable warehouses or storage areas, constituting the same as virtual customs warehouses for this purpose. The expenses shall be for the account of the Bureau taken from the Forfeiture Fund.

ai.title: Transport at Storage ng Seized Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pwedeng gumamit ng transport facilities at mag-designate ng storage areas bilang 'virtual customs warehouses' para sa seized goods, na babayaran mula sa Forfeiture Fund.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi kailangan ng purpose-built na warehouse - pwedeng gumamit ng existing facilities na i-classify bilang 'virtual' customs warehouse.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Related sa CMTA Title XI Ch.10 Sec.1151(b) tungkol sa Forfeiture Fund.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.5.h ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa transport at storage ng seized goods gamit ang Forfeiture Fund. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Special Customs Area. For reasons of security, safety and economy, the Commissioner may constitute the premises upon which foreign goods are openly offered for sale, or kept in storage, as a special customs area for the duration of the exercise of the power to visit and inspect or other proceedings related thereto.

ai.title: Special Customs Area
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Para sa security, safety, at economy reasons, pwedeng i-constitute ng Commissioner ang isang premises bilang 'special customs area' habang ongoing ang power to visit and inspect.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Parang pansamantalang 'declare' na customs territory ang isang private na lugar habang may proceedings.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.6 ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa Special Customs Area. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: The Bureau may conduct the inventory, examination, appraisal, assessment and/or collection of duties and taxes due on the foreign goods in such special customs area.

ai.title: Mga Gagawin sa Special Customs Area
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pwedeng gawin ng BOC ang inventory, examination, appraisal, assessment, at collection ng duties/taxes habang nasa special customs area.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Lahat ng functions na dapat gawin sa regular customs zone ay pwede ring gawin sa special customs area.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.6.a ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa mga gagawin sa Special Customs Area. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: b.
paragraphs.text: The goods are deemed, for all intents and purposes, in customs custody.

ai.title: Goods sa Customs Custody
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Habang nasa special customs area, ang goods ay deemed in customs custody para sa lahat ng intents and purposes.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kahit private pa rin ang lugar, legal na treatment ng goods ay parang nasa customs custody na sila.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.6.b ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa customs custody status ng goods sa Special Customs Area. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: In all instances, a Customs Operations Officer III (COO III) shall be designated in the Special Customs Area for purposes of valuation and computation of duties and taxes.

ai.title: COO III sa Special Customs Area
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dapat may designated Customs Operations Officer III (COO III) sa Special Customs Area para sa valuation at computation ng duties and taxes.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Specific role ito - COO III ang magha-handle ng technical computation sa special customs area.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang requirement ng COO III sa Special Customs Area sa Sec. 4.6.6. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Submission of Report Including Assessment of Implementation, Observations and Recommendations. The Customs Officer exercising the power to visit and inspect shall render progress reports during and after the actual visit, and shall submit the final report, including the inventory report signed by the COO III, to the Commissioner within twenty-four (24) hours after the conclusion of the proceedings.

ai.title: Submission of Report
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dapat magbigay ng progress reports habang at pagkatapos ng visit, at magsumite ng final report (kasama ang inventory report ng COO III) sa Commissioner sa loob ng 24 oras pagkatapos ng proceedings.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Katulad ng after-mission report ng Mission Order, may 24-hour reporting requirement din ang LOA proceedings.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 4.6.7 ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa Submission of Report. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Accountability. For the purpose of transparency, all LOAs issued shall be recorded and include the following:

ai.title: Panimula: Accountability sa LOA
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Panimula bago ilista ang mga detalye na kailangang i-record sa bawat LOA para sa transparency.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi lang basta issue-han ng LOA - dapat may paper trail na ma-track.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang panimula ng Sec. 4.6.8 ng CAO 03-2019 tungkol sa Accountability sa LOA. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: Date issued;

ai.title: Date Issued
